signature: A still, sunlit sea that never ends, broken by weatherboard houses on long stilts; a village of nine houses and a landing joined by rope bridges, a Deep Eye falling away into the dark east of it, a house whose roof snow never melts, and far out, grey giants wading with houses on their backs.

exits.method: multiple exits in the Deep Eyes
exits.source_quote: In the Deep Eyes multiple Level 8 exits were found.
exits.label: Swam into a dark opening in the wall of a Deep Eye
exits.hint: The Deep Eye east of the village. Go down.
exits.implemented_as: created only once you dive below the seabed inside the Eye (not navmesh-reachable)

exits.method: entrance in stilt houses with unmelting snow on the roof
exits.source_quote: there is an entrance to Level 7.7
exits.label: Stepped into a stilt house whose roof snow never melts
exits.hint: Look for snow on a roof under the glaring sun.

exits.source_quote: rifts to other realities, ships of incomprehensible size
exits.label: Cast off in a deserted boat toward the distant waves
exits.hint: Deserted boats drift among the houses. Nobody has maps.

notes: SOURCE: sub-section deep in Level 7; extensive calm saline sea with no discernible end; minimal waves; seabed 20 m down (rocks, sand, metals, coral); holes up to 12,000 m deep; safest crossing by boat, diving acceptable; deserted drifting vessels; houses on stilts of wood, metal and concrete, villages of about ten structures joined by bridges; concrete-column houses best stocked and safest; bridges may break, stilts may snap; Deep Eyes semi-dark with coral and fish, used for fishing, Level 8 exits in them; snow-roofed houses (snow never melts) hold an entrance to Level 7.7; Seawalkers 40-70 m, four-legged, crab-like, grey, white empty eyes, wear stilt houses as shells, groups of 3+, only in water <= 20 m, not aggressive; seagulls domesticated and nesting in houses; tropical fish. TESTIMONY (Captain's Journal, 1705): constant time of day, compasses spinning, a metal box that plays music only you can hear. ADAPTATION: the village layout, house designs and paint colours are ours (the page gives no map); the authored Deep Eye is 76 m across (the largest is 4 km) and its floor is a dark abyss at -175 m; its Level 8 opening is placed at -48 m on the south-west wall and is created only once you dive into the Eye; the weak bridge is one of two seeded side bridges and stays broken in a story save; the sea is a finite 4.4 km window with streamed lone houses and boats, and a gentle current turns swimmers back past 1.5 km; oxygen 80 s; Seawalkers walk a fixed 330 m circuit and never approach (their danger is lore only); casting off in the boat is the rumoured voyage (EXT#3) and is labelled as rumour; communities (Grand Colony, Leilah, Deepfallow Corsairs) are mentioned only in a note, not built; no route back to Level 7 (none is stated).
entity_policy: SOURCED ENTITIES ONLY: Seawalkers (three, non-aggressive, far off, in shallow water); seagulls and fish are non-entity fauna.
